## SASP markers by p21/p16 positivity
```{r}
remotes::install_github("genomics-kl/seurathelpeR")
library(seurathelpeR)

devtools::install_version("ggplot2", "3.5.2", force = TRUE) #downgrading ggplot because of S4SXP error

Idents(codex) <- 'age'

f <- c("BCL2", "PCNA","HMGB1", "CXCR3", "IP10", "IL6", "IL8", "hIL-1alpha", "LaminB1")

add_title_ggplot(VlnPlot(object = codex, layer='scale.data', features = f, group.by = "p16",  pt.size = 0)  & stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.signif", label.y.npc = 'top', label.x.npc = 'center') &
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("neg" = "#296d9e", "pos" = "#cc0b01")) &
 stat_summary(fun = mean, geom='crossbar', width = 0.5, position=position_dodge(1)) & labs(y = "Intensity", x = element_blank()),
                 'Intensity of SASP markers in p16+ cells in combined samples') 
ggsave(filename = "//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/codex_youngold_saspvln_p16.svg", device = "svg", width=10, height=12, dpi=500)

#296d9e
#cc0b01

add_title_ggplot(VlnPlot(object = codex, layer='scale.data', features = f, group.by = "p21",  pt.size = 0)  & stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.signif", label.y.npc = 'top', label.x.npc = 'center') &
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("neg" = "#296d9e", "pos" = "#cc0b01"))  & stat_summary(fun = mean, geom='crossbar', width = 0.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) & labs(y = "Intensity", x = element_blank()),
                 'Intensity of SASP markers in p21+ cells in combined samples')
ggsave(filename = "//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/codex_youngold_saspvln_p21.svg", device = "svg", width=10, height=12, dpi=500)


add_title_ggplot(VlnPlot(object = codex, layer='scale.data', features = f, group.by = "sencelltype",  pt.size = 0)  & stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.signif", label.y.npc = 'top', label.x.npc = 'center') &
 scale_fill_manual(values = c("SnC-" = "#296d9e", "SnC+" = "#cc0b01"))  & stat_summary(fun = mean, geom='crossbar', width = 0.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) & labs(y = "Intensity", x = element_blank()),
```

## Cell type proportions by SnC+

```{r}
# SnC+ saved in codex$sencelltype

CD4 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD4",] > 0.0
CD68 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD68",] > 0.0
CD8 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD8",] > 0.0
FOXP3 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["FOXP3",] > 0.0
#CD11c <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD11c",] > 0.0
CD14 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD14",] > 0.0
CXCR3 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CXCR3",] > 0.0
CD45 <- codex@assays$RNA$counts["CD45",] > 0.0


codex@meta.data$immcelltype <- case_when(
  CD8 ~ "CD8+",
  CD4  & FOXP3 ~ "CD4+ FOXP3+",
  CD4  & CXCR3 ~ "CD4+ CXCR3+",
  CD14 ~ "CD14+",
 # CD11c ~ "CD11c+",
  CD45 ~ "CD45+",
  CD68 ~ "CD68+",
  CD4 ~ "CD4+",
  TRUE ~ 'none'
)

age_groups <- c('old', 'young')

mycols <- c("#bebebe", "#cd8729") # #3156a6

for (current_age in age_groups) {
    
    cat(paste("Processing data for age group:", current_age, "\n"))
    
    # 1. Subset the Seurat object for the current age group
    seurat_subset <- subset(codex, subset = age == current_age)
    
    # 2. Calculate the cell type vs. p21 contingency table
    # Var1 will be cell_types, Var2 will be p21, Freq will be counts
    immsen <- as.data.frame(table(seurat_subset$immcelltype, seurat_subset$sencelltype))
    
    # 3. Calculate relative frequency (proportion)
    your_data <- immsen %>%
        group_by(Var1) %>%
        # Calculate frequency as proportion of the total for that cell type
        mutate(Freq = Freq / sum(Freq)) %>%
        ungroup()
    
    # 4. Clean up columns and filter 'none'
    colnames(your_data) <- c('cell_types', 'SnC', 'Freq')
    your_data <- your_data[your_data$cell_types != "none", ]
    
    # 5. Calculate percentages and text positioning
    your_data$Freq <- round(your_data$Freq * 100, 2)
    
    your_data <- your_data %>%
        arrange(cell_types, desc(SnC)) %>% # Arrange correctly for stacking
        group_by(cell_types) %>%
        # Calculate y-position for text labels
        mutate(lab.ypos = cumsum(Freq) - 0.5 * Freq) %>%
        ungroup()
    
    # 6. Define the output file name
    # The file name will be unique for each age group (e.g., codex_young_p21.png)
    output_filename <- paste0("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/codex_y_", current_age, "_immsnc.png")
    
    # 7. Start graphics device (PNG)
    # Using the second filename you provided for consistency
    png(output_filename, res = 500, width = 30, height = 8, units = 'in', pointsize = 4)
    
    # 8. Generate the plot
    p <- ggplot(your_data, aes(x = "", y = Freq, group = SnC, color = SnC, fill = SnC)) +
        geom_bar(width = 2, stat = "identity", color = "white") +
        coord_polar("y", start = 0) + # Creates the pie/donut chart effect
        geom_text(aes(y = lab.ypos, label = paste0(Freq, "%")), color = "black", size = 5) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = mycols) +
        facet_wrap(~ cell_types, ncol = 10) + # Use facet_wrap for better display of many types
        labs(
            title = paste("SnC+ by Cell Type in", Hmisc::capitalize(current_age), "Skin"),
            fill = "Senescent Status"
        ) +
        theme_void() +
        theme(
            strip.text = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
            plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 2),
            legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
            legend.title = element_text(size = 15)
        )
    
    print(p)
    
    # 9. Close graphics device and save file
    dev.off()
    
    cat(paste("Successfully saved plot to:", output_filename, "\n"))
}

```

## Stacked bar plots for cell type proportions

```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)


### Immune cells ###

immsen <- as.data.frame(table(codex$sample, codex$immcelltype))

cells <- as.data.frame(immsen %>%
                           group_by(Var1) %>%
                           mutate(Freq = Freq / sum(Freq)))
cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'none',]
#cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'CD45+',]

cells <- cells %>%
  group_by(Var1) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Freq * 100, 1))  # Convert proportion to percentage

stacked_barplot <- ggplot(cells, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2))+
  # 1. Change the color palette to a professional, muted scheme
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "RdGy") + # "Set2" is a good choice for discrete, muted data +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +  # Black borders
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 4, color = "black") +  # Percentage labels inside bars
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Immune Cell Types in Young vs. Old",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Immune Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    # Explicitly remove gridlines and background elements if using theme_minimal
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

# Display the plot
print(stacked_barplot)
####

ggsave("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/codex_yo_immunecells_bar_sample.png", plot = stacked_barplot, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 500)


### Skin cells ###
skinsen <- as.data.frame(table(codex$sample, codex$skincelltype))

cells <- as.data.frame(skinsen %>%
                           group_by(Var1) %>%
                           mutate(Freq = Freq / sum(Freq)))
cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'none',]
#cells <- cells[cells$Var2 != 'CD45+',]

cells <- cells %>%
  group_by(Var1) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = round(Freq * 100, 1))  # Convert proportion to percentage

stacked_barplot <- ggplot(cells, aes(x = Var1, y = Freq, fill = Var2))+
  # 1. Change the color palette to a professional, muted scheme
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "PiYG") + # "Set2" is a good choice for discrete, muted data +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", color = "black") +  # Black borders
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(Percentage, "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            size = 4, color = "black") +  # Percentage labels inside bars
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Skin Cell Types in Young vs. Old",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Skin Cell Types"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    # Explicitly remove gridlines and background elements if using theme_minimal
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  )

# Display the plot
print(stacked_barplot)
####

ggsave("//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/codex_yo_skincells_bar_samples.png", plot = stacked_barplot, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 500)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# --- Settings (match your metadata) ---
age_col  <- "age"          # codex$age has 'young'/'old'
snc_col  <- "sencelltype"  # codex$sencelltype has 'SnC+'/'SnC-'
p21_col  <- "p21"          # codex$p21 has 'pos'/'neg'
blue_col <- "#296d9e"      # your blue

# 1) Summarize p21+ SnC percentage in the *entire* population, per age
df <- codex@meta.data %>%
  mutate(
    Age = factor(.data[[age_col]], levels = c("young", "old")),
    is_p21pos_snc = (.data[[snc_col]] == "SnC+" & .data[[p21_col]] == "pos")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Age) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_p21pos_snc = sum(is_p21pos_snc, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop = n_p21pos_snc / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Plot (single blue bar per age)
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Age, y = prop)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, fill = blue_col) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1)),
            vjust = -0.4, size = 8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Proportion of p21+ SnCs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 26)

print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = "//mfad/researchmn/PHYS-BIOMED-ENG/PASSOS/SHARED/Yeaeun/ana/skin_mapping_2/results/codex_youngold_p21_SnCpos.png",
  width = 4, height = 8, dpi = 500
)


# (optional sanity check)
df %>% mutate(prop_pct = round(prop * 100, 4))


```
